findings: Fallback fixture is a test dependency: the three commands.rs fallback tests and four lib.rs e2e tests load example.module.json. It exists at docs/ (not Documents/) on this branch, matching all assertions. If run on a branch missing it, those tests fail with a clear 'fixture not found' message, not a compile error. Scaffold unit tests do no I/O and pass regardless. Note for the dev running cargo test.

override_or has a redundant lifetime: fn override_or<'a>(over: &'a Option<String>, preset: &'a str) -> String ties two input lifetimes though it returns an owned String. Harmless and compiles; the 'a can be dropped for clarity. Cosmetic only.
Subject is intentionally not overridable by the teacher once a scaffold is picked. By design and documented, not a bug; flagged so the UI lane knows the field is fixed.

No live Groq call is exercised by the suite (call_groq is the only network function and is not unit-tested, by design). End-to-end generate_from_scaffold against the real API is only verifiable with a valid GROQ_API_KEY; without it the command falls back, which is intended.
